outcome: duration of the second stage of labor
cohort: Expectant mothers admitted to the hospital from January 2023 to June 2023 were divided into a prenatal yoga exercise group and a non-prenatal yoga exercise group.
finding: Prenatal yoga exercise significantly reduced stress levels, increased psychological resilience, shortened the second stage of labor, and improved overall pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The prenatal yoga group exhibited lower rates of forceps delivery and cesarean section, and a higher rate of vaginal delivery.
